title: The Free Press’s El-Sayed Derangement Syndrome Comes Back to Bite It
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here. In today's edition, we dive into how Bari Weiss's
obsession with Abdul El-Sayed ultimately led to embarrassing foul-ups at The
Free Press that even the anti-woke blog had to admit went too far. Plus, a CBS
News story on El-Sayed sparks an internal fight, and a pro-Trump channel's
dwindling audience may have been the canary in the coal mine for the death of
MAGA.

It would appear that the election of America's first Muslim senator may have
further broken the brains over at **Bari Weiss 's** right-wing, pro-Israel
website The Free Press.

In the immediate aftermath of progressive Democrat **Abdul El-Sayed** winning
the Michigan Senate race, the anti-woke blog - which **David Ellison 's**
Skydance bought for $150 million last year - saw one of its staff writers use
generative AI to surreptitiously alter a photo while another reporter outright
lied about El-Sayed's victory speech.

These embarrassing misfires also came at the worst time for Weiss.
